Package nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.domain.entities

Class AbstractEntity

java.lang.Object
nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.domain.entities.AbstractEntity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Entity
Direct Known Subclasses:
Item, MoveableEntity
public abstract class AbstractEntity extends Object implements Entity
AbstractEntity is a abstract class implementing all the fields and methods that are common to all entities
